public.title: Squares of a Sorted Array
public.description: values is a nondecreasing array of 0 to 1000 integers between -10000 and 10000. Return all squared values in nondecreasing order. Duplicates are retained. Aim for linear time.
hints: The largest square lies at one of the two ends.
Fill the output from largest to smallest.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026, for a standard algorithmic problem. No third-party exercise text or solution code used.

explanation: Compare endpoint magnitudes and place the larger square at the next free position from the right. O(n) time and O(n) output space.
